# Results (step 6 evidence)

Everything here is computed from the bot's own SQLite logs by
`uv run python scripts/evidence.py --runs runs --out results` (the databases are not
committed). Where a fact comes from the PIPELINE.md log rather than a database, the file
says so. Numbers are stated as computed; consecutive decisions overlap, so decision counts
overstate the number of independent samples.

| R3 unattended run | taker | decider | VM | overnight.db |
| R4 maker paper run | maker | mock | Mac | maker30.db |
| R5 maker live run, killed by the M9 bug | maker | decider | VM | maker_live.db |
| R6 maker live run | maker | decider | VM, model relayed through the Mac | maker_live2.db |

| [baselines.md](baselines.md) | E6 baselines and ablations | Model or recalibrated model beat the base rate out of sample in: no cell; the one-line momentum heuristic in: R3 30 s (upper bound -0.0004); 2 of 18 intervals at 95% exclude zero (1 below, 1 above; 3 too few samples to read); about 0.9 would by chance alone, and 2 or more would 23% of the time, so the cells below zero are not evidence of an edge. AUC interval above 0.5: R6 30 s (0.686), R6 60 s (0.647) (a lead from R6 (1.0 h) of testnet, not an edge). R3's would-be trades at gate 0.60 were no better than all decisions. |

The sample is too small to claim anything about the model either way: at most
356 non-overlapping outcome windows in any one calibration row, where
PROBLEM.md expected a few thousand decisions to be needed.
